Digital Assets Production Support & SRE Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description_html: Citi is looking for a Digital Assets Production Support & SRE Analyst to own the reliability and operational integrity of business-critical digital asset platforms, including blockchain-connected systems, digital wallets, and high-throughput transaction processing infrastructure. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority — bridging engineering, operations, and business teams to resolve complex platform challenges and drive measurable improvements in system stability. You will directly shape how Citi's digital asset capabilities perform at scale, influencing both the day-to-day resilience of the platform and its long-term engineering direction.      Why Join Us?   Be part of a team building and supporting Citi's next-generation Digital Assets platform. You'll gain exposure to cutting-edge technology, work at the intersection of capital markets and blockchain innovation, and help shape the future of tokenized financial products within a global institution.      Responsibilities:      Provide production support for Citi's Digital Asset platforms and services.    Monitor platform health and respond to incidents impacting production environments.    Investigate and resolve application, infrastructure, and data-related issues.    Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent fixes for recurring problems.    Partner with development teams to improve platform stability, observability, and automation.    Support software releases and ensure production readiness of new functionality.    Develop and maintain operational runbooks, monitoring, and support documentation.    Communicate effectively with business and technology stakeholders during incidents.    Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, efficiency, and risk reduction.    Ensure adherence to operational controls, regulatory requirements, and Citi standards.        Qualifications:      5-8 years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, SRE, or Platform Engineering.    Experience supporting business-critical, high-availability systems.    Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.    Solid Linux and SQL knowledge.    Experience with scripting and automation using Java, Python, or similar technologies.    Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, ELK, or Prometheus.    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.    Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.        Strongly Preferred:      Markets and/or Electronic Trading technology experience.    Experience supporting real-time trading, execution, pricing, or market infrastructure platforms.    Background in Exchange, FinTech, or Payments technology.    Knowledge of distributed systems and large-scale production environments.        Nice to Have:      Digital Assets, Blockchain, or Tokenization platform experience.    Understanding of digital custody, wallets, or key management solutions.    Kubernetes, OpenShift, and cloud-native technologies.    Knowledge of digital asset market structure and operations.        Education:       Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience.                      ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Applications Support            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $96,400.00 - $144,600.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description_html: Role Description  The delivery Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for delivering high quality Digital Experience and Digital Marketing solutions for Adobe's Global Enterprise customers. Review and develop architectural plans, lead diverse delivery team, align with client goals.   Minimum Qualifications     Past experience in a consultative role leading large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems in the role of Architect and/or Principal Consultant.    4+ years' experience hands-on architecting and/or implementing  three or more  of the following Adobe Experience Cloud solution categories:    Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics    Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign or Marketo Engage    Adobe Real-Time CDP or Audience Manager    Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) including App Builder    Adobe Commerce/Magento or another e-commerce solution that integrated with AEM    Adobe Target or Recommendations    Adobe Experience Platform (Schema, Query Services, etc.)    Adobe Workfront Workflow, Planning, or Fusion    GenStudio, Express, or Firefly Services (< 3 years)      Strong leadership abilities (an example being proactively convert complex business requirements into technical "solutions") which aligns all delivery team activities to documented customer Business Objectives.    Experience producing project scope definitions, delivery estimations, resource allocation and project timelines based on product licensing purchase and implementation requirements.    Ability to quickly diagnose delivery challenges and formulate effective remediation plans to adhere to scope, schedule and budget.    Demonstrable hands-on experience using enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) with an emphasis on REST APIs, Cloud Storage, Structured/Unstructured Data, Security and Data Ingress/Egress.    Experience leading cross-functional, multi-region delivery teams.    Proficient in written and verbal communications with the ability to adjust communications as needed for Technical, Marketing and/or C-Suite customers.    Ability to travel up to 20% of the time within the United States and occasionally internationally.    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience.       Skills that Set You Apart     One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications (AEM, AJO, Analytics/CJA, RTCDP, Target or Workfront)    Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing journey including Ad Tech (CDP/DMPs, DSPs, etc.), Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Content Management or automation, CRM, Media Execution, and Reporting/Insights.    Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications.    Proficiency in employing Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions to optimize daily workflows or hands-on experience with building AI agents.      About Adobe   Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
